title: sin(1)'s even-count partial sums are a lower bracket
statement: For every m, sumRange sinTerm (m+m) <= sinOne -- mirrors CReal.cosOne_alternating_lower exactly, at sinTerm's own magnitude sequence (b j := expTerm(2j+1)), instantiating CReal.alternatingLowerBound (this batch) with CReal.sinOneConverges (this batch) as the limit hypothesis and CReal.expTerm_antitone (this batch) for the required decrease premise.

formal.statement: theorem CReal.sinOne_alternating_lower : ((x0 : AxNat) -> CReal.le (CReal.sumRange CReal.sinTerm (AxNat.add x0 x0)) CReal.sinOne)

evidence.supports: CReal.sinOne_alternating_lower is admitted by the trusted kernel gate with the type recorded in formal.statement.
